content: At the current right-Piper fixture,20mm grasp/23mm align and16mm grasp/23mm align both produced full simulation successes but failed their real frozen-reference executions. A complete release/fold sequence also failed physically. Do not reuse simulation success or unchanged gripper width as proof of real stable retention or insertion.
applicability: Current right-only Piper, RGB-only, original speed and1.0N.m command, target socket3; current scene/configuration hashes in batch2 reports
count_unit: Two distinct real executions, different grasp heights; not independent fixed-policy reliability trials
known_limits: Static real-width substitution assumes simulated object pose and cannot identify a unique parameter
One raw capture has unresolved timing/export rejection
Historical successful grasp heights are not validated under the present grip/contact state

next_checks.when: A paired real execution failed despite simulation success
next_checks.check: Read the paired outcome and existing phase/contact evidence before repeating unchanged parameters.

next_checks.when: Plug is grasped but insertion differs
next_checks.check: Compare plug-to-gripper pose across lift, alignment and insertion; motor aperture alone is insufficient. Real relative pose is still UNKNOWN.
